course_name: 材料特性與熱管理實務應用
outline: 在諸多工程應用實例中，如LED、晶片之散熱問題、流體在能源系統中之熱交換、燃料電池衍生之熱問題等，都與材料之規格選用、處理方法、加工方式、製造過程有明顯的相關性。本門課程主要針對材料工程與熱管理相關的技術問題，提出探討與對策，期使學生對熱管理在材料與系統工程上的應用提供適當的專業知識。
schedule:

1.	2/23  Overall view of the lecture

5.	CFD-purpose lecture & 熱力學循環與循環分析
6.	The Integrated Study of Solar and Ocean Energy
7.	CFD Analysis to the Two-Phase Flow Induced Thermal-Hydraulic Phenomena within ABWR Containment
8.	Introduction of thin film materials and their technology-Part 1(Processes)
9.	校外人士演講I (雙師計畫)
10.	分組報告I
11.	校外人士演講II (雙師計畫)
12.	分組報告II
13.	分組報告III & final exam
14.	Introduction of thin film materials and their technology-Part 2(Analysis and Characterization of Thin Films)
15.  The Cutting Edge Materials-Diamond Films and their Applications
16.  Fabrications and Applications of Nano-Materials
17.  Specific Topics1
18.  Specific Topics 2
